name: motif_try_word
description:
Trace a word. Runs PanGloss for one word against the project's current Baseline and returns its diagnostic. Use it to inspect recorded analyses and trace events.
Command: trace. Agent class: Evaluate.
Word: The exact word form to trace.
ProposalId: The Proposal whose latest Trial to trace; omitted traces the project evidence.

proposal.description: A proposal id: parse the word with that Draft or Proposal's changes, in the copy of its latest motif_trial. Omit to parse against the current Baseline.

detail.description: 'concise' (default) drops empty fields and long lists; 'detailed' returns everything.

limit.description: Page size for paged reads (findings, operations: default 10; proposals list: default 25), and the most list items in concise mode elsewhere (default 25).

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
